| # | Lesson | Level | Status | What you learn |

| 01 | Hyperparameter Tuning | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Grid search, random search, and Bayesian optimization. |
| 02 | Advanced HPO & Bayesian Search (Optuna) | 🟢 Beginner | 🛠️ in progress | Bayesian hyperparameter search beyond grid and random search. |
| 03 | Bayesian Optimization for Training (Optuna - BoTorch) | 🔴 Expert | 🛠️ in progress | Hyperparameter search guided by probabilistic surrogate models. |
| 04 | High-Speed Tabular AutoML (FLAML) | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Fast, resource-aware automated model selection for tabular data. |
| 05 | State-of-the-Art Ensembling (AutoGluon) | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Automated stacked ensembling for maximal predictive performance. |
| 06 | Neural Architecture Search & Hyperband | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Automated architecture search with early-stopping-based budget allocation. |
